# TC-CLI-267 现有配置损坏（非法 JSON / repo 已变成普通文件）时 get 报 E_USAGE，
# 但 set 仍可用来修复它

env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$WORK/xdg
env HOME=$WORK/home

mkdir $WORK/xdg/databackup
cp broken.json $WORK/xdg/databackup/config.json
exec expect 2 --json config get
stdout '"type":"error","code":"E_USAGE"'

exec databackup --json config set repo $WORK/repo
cmpenv stdout want-set.jsonl

exec databackup --json config get
cmpenv stdout want-set.jsonl

# repo 指向的路径后来被替换成普通文件
mkdir $WORK/other
exec databackup --json config set repo $WORK/other/repo
cp broken.json $WORK/other/repo
exec expect 2 --json config get
stdout '"type":"error","code":"E_USAGE"'

exec databackup --json config set repo $WORK/repo
cmpenv stdout want-set.jsonl

-- broken.json --
{not json
-- want-set.jsonl --
{"type":"result","command":"config","repo":"$WORK/repo"}
